svg.title: Turbonomic in three of IBM’s published results
svg.desc: 45,000 automated resourcing actions a month for the IBM CIO Organization. More than 175,000 automated resourcing actions in four months for IBM Technology Zone, run by nine infrastructure engineers. 70% faster resourcing decisions for APIS IT, using IBM Instana and Turbonomic together. Each is a customer result as IBM reports it; results vary by client.
